services.desc: Enjoy a trip of Cruising & Fishing on the Water! Duration 3, 4, 6 or 8 Hours About Fins Up Charters is a great charter boat for families and groups. We welcome all ages and people of any skill level. We are very kid friendly and extremely patient, No Experience is Needed!! We teach the novice fisherman and we are willing to share all of our skills and expertise with the experts! The Boat is a Custom Built 32 ft Downeast. She is very stable and comfortable with an enclosed cabin and full size bathroom. NOTE: Our 3hr trip is primarily suited to very young
